source_artifact.content_excerpt: The Orchestrate run record lives at a single fixed path, .orchestrate/run.json, and no subcommand accepts a flag selecting which run to act on. A stale or completed run record therefore stands in the way of starting the next run, and two runs cannot coexist. Found during the Auralis preflight on installed Orchestrate 3.0.7.

title: Orchestrate keeps one run record at a fixed path so a stale run blocks the next and two runs cannot coexist
